title: 自訂動作列出現延遲
summary: 可微調選取文字後自動顯示動作列的時間，自動複製與快捷鍵維持原有時機。
highlights: 滑桿與毫秒輸入框同步，支援 0 至 2,000 毫秒，預設 120 毫秒。
0 毫秒表示不額外延遲，仍會保留讀取選取內容前的等待。
usage: 啟動 Windows 版 SnapBar，在一般設定開啟「自動顯示動作列」後，調整「動作列出現延遲」。輸入毫秒後按 Enter 儲存，或按「還原預設」回到 120 毫秒。

en.title: Set the toolbar appearance delay
en.summary: Fine-tune when the toolbar appears automatically after selecting text. Auto-copy and shortcuts keep their existing timing.
highlights: The slider and milliseconds field stay in sync. Choose 0 to 2,000 milliseconds, with 120 as the default.
Setting 0 adds no delay. The selection capture wait still applies.
en.usage: Open SnapBar on Windows and turn on Show toolbar automatically in General settings. Adjust Toolbar appearance delay and press Enter to save a typed value, or choose Reset to default to restore 120 milliseconds.
